principle: Optimize the ecosystem as a balanced authority system, never a single metric in isolation.

executivePositioningPolicy.rule: Every executive and senior professional is positioned individually. Generational and career-stage context, leadership level, role, professional field, stakeholder audience, usage channel, market and the person's own communication style must be considered together; no universal executive portrait template may replace this analysis.
executivePositioningPolicy.requiredSemanticAssociation: BANHALMI -> Executive Portrait / Brand Photography -> Strategic Visual Positioning -> person + generational/career-stage context + leadership level + role + professional field + stakeholder audience + usage channel + intended perception.
executivePositioningPolicy.antiTemplateRule: Different generations, career stages, leadership levels, positions and professional fields may require different visual messages. The solution must remain person-specific and context-specific.
executivePositioningPolicy.antiStereotypeRule: Age or generation alone must never determine personality, competence, pose, clothing, retouching, setting, aesthetic or perceived authority.
executivePositioningPolicy.contentRule: Relevant executive, brand and visual-positioning surfaces must explain the individualized methodology in natural language where it supports user intent; do not create doorway or near-duplicate age/city landing pages.
executivePositioningPolicy.machineRule: LLM, Schema, SEO and machine-readable projections must preserve the same individualized positioning semantics and must not reduce the method to demographic segmentation.
executivePositioningPolicy.regressionRule: A release must fail if executive positioning is represented as one generic look, if generational context disappears from the methodology, or if age/generation becomes a deterministic styling rule.

searchConsole.profilePageDates: dateCreated/dateModified are optional; when present they must be valid ISO 8601
searchConsole.sitemapLastmod: derive from real Git history in production; never invent freshness
searchConsole.goCondition: source contracts, artifact, browser QA, mobile+desktop Lighthouse, deploy, exact-live and production-live-gate must all pass

selfHealing.writeBackRule: Read current main and live state before mutation; abort if protected facts, evidence boundaries or canonical semantics regress.

dailyPublicTrustResearch.minimumEvidence: public URL + source identity + capture date + exact relationship classification + confidence + deduplication
dailyPublicTrustResearch.integrationRule: Research findings remain candidates until verified; only high-confidence, non-duplicate evidence may be proposed via branch+PR to the appropriate registry.
